props.label: About the Clinic
props.heading: Healthy smiles, gentle care, advanced treatment
props.body:
Welcome to Dr. Aayas Dental Clinic, where healthy smiles and patient comfort come first. We provide advanced dental treatments with modern technology and personalised care to ensure the best oral health for every patient.

The clinic is led by Dr. Sumeet Aya and covers everything from a routine cleaning to implants, braces and surgical work — so most treatment can be completed in one place rather than sending you elsewhere.

We would rather explain than rush. You are told what we have found, what the options are and what each involves, and nothing starts until you are comfortable with the plan. Digital X-rays are taken on site and reviewed with you during the same visit.

At Dr. Aayas Dental Clinic, we are dedicated to giving you confident and beautiful smiles.

props.label: Our Treatments
props.heading: What we treat
props.sub: General, cosmetic and surgical dentistry under one roof. Tap any treatment to ask about it on WhatsApp.

items.title: Teeth Whitening
items.desc: Professional in-clinic whitening that lifts staining from tea, coffee, tobacco and age. Shade is assessed before and after so you can see the change.

items.title: Veeners
items.desc: Thin custom shells bonded to the front of the teeth to correct chips, gaps, worn edges and stubborn discolouration. Shade and shape are chosen with you first.

items.title: Checkups
items.desc: A full examination of teeth, gums and bite, with digital X-rays where needed. You leave knowing exactly what, if anything, needs doing and in what order.

items.title: Dental Implants
items.desc: A titanium post placed in the jaw to replace a missing tooth root, later restored with a crown. Includes planning, placement and the healing review.

items.title: Dentures & Bridges
items.desc: Removable dentures and fixed bridges to replace missing teeth and restore chewing. Fit is adjusted over follow-up visits until it is comfortable.

items.title: Oral Surgery
items.desc: Surgical extractions including impacted and wisdom teeth, carried out under local anaesthesia with written aftercare instructions.

items.title: Fillings & Sealants
items.desc: Decay removed and the cavity restored, plus protective sealants on the biting surfaces of back teeth to prevent decay starting.

items.title: Orthodontics Treatment
items.desc: Braces and aligners to correct crowding, spacing and bite problems, with regular adjustment visits through the course of treatment.

items.title: Kids Dentistry
items.desc: Check-ups, fluoride application, sealants and fillings for children, at a pace that keeps the visit calm and unhurried.

props.sub: Eighteen treatments covering routine care, cosmetic work, replacement of missing teeth and surgery. Costs are confirmed after an examination — message us and we will tell you what is involved.

items.title: Teeth Whitening
items.desc: Professional in-clinic whitening that lifts staining from tea, coffee, tobacco and age. Shade is assessed before and after so you can see the change.

items.title: Veeners
items.desc: Thin custom shells bonded to the front of the teeth to correct chips, gaps, worn edges and stubborn discolouration. Shade and shape are chosen with you first.

items.title: Checkups
items.desc: A full examination of teeth, gums and bite, with digital X-rays where needed. You leave knowing exactly what, if anything, needs doing and in what order.

items.title: Dental Implants
items.desc: A titanium post placed in the jaw to replace a missing tooth root, later restored with a crown. Includes planning, placement and the healing review.

items.title: Dentures & Bridges
items.desc: Removable dentures and fixed bridges to replace missing teeth and restore chewing. Fit is adjusted over follow-up visits until it is comfortable.

items.title: Oral Surgery
items.desc: Surgical extractions including impacted and wisdom teeth, carried out under local anaesthesia with written aftercare instructions.

items.title: Fillings & Sealants
items.desc: Decay removed and the cavity restored, plus protective sealants on the biting surfaces of back teeth to prevent decay starting.

items.title: Orthodontics Treatment
items.desc: Braces and aligners to correct crowding, spacing and bite problems, with regular adjustment visits through the course of treatment.

items.title: Kids Dentistry
items.desc: Check-ups, fluoride application, sealants and fillings for children, at a pace that keeps the visit calm and unhurried.

items.title: Root Canal
items.desc: Treatment for an infected or badly decayed tooth: the nerve space is cleaned, disinfected and sealed, then the tooth is capped to protect it.

items.title: Teeth Cleaning
items.desc: Removal of plaque and hardened tartar above and below the gumline — the routine treatment for bleeding gums and persistent bad breath.

items.title: Complete Denture
items.desc: A full upper or lower denture where all teeth are missing, made from impressions and adjusted across follow-ups for a comfortable fit.

items.title: Gum Surgery
items.desc: Surgical treatment for advanced gum disease and overgrown or receding gum tissue, where cleaning alone is not enough.

items.title: Periodontal Surgery
items.desc: Deeper treatment of the bone and tissue supporting the teeth in established periodontitis, aimed at stabilising teeth that have become loose.

items.title: Scaling and Polishing
items.desc: Ultrasonic scaling to lift tartar, followed by polishing to smooth the tooth surface so plaque is slower to build back up.

items.title: Digital X ray
items.desc: On-site digital radiographs with lower radiation than film, viewable immediately so findings can be explained to you during the same visit.

items.title: Crown and Brideges
items.desc: Custom crowns to cap a weakened or root-treated tooth, and bridges to span a gap using the neighbouring teeth for support.

items.title: Tooth Coloured Filling
items.desc: Composite fillings matched to your natural tooth shade, bonded directly so less healthy tooth needs to be removed than with metal.

items.q: Do I need an appointment, or can I walk in?
items.a: Both work. Walk-ins are seen between booked slots, so there may be a wait. Booking ahead means you are seen at your slot time. For pain or swelling, call or message on WhatsApp and we will fit you in the same day wherever possible.

Local anaesthesia is used for anything that would otherwise be uncomfortable, and we check you are numb before starting. Tell us if you are anxious or have had a difficult experience before — we will go slower and explain each step as we go.

Cost depends on what the examination finds, so we give you the figure after looking, before any treatment starts. For longer treatments like implants, braces or full dentures you get the full plan and cost in writing first.

items.q: How many visits will I need?
items.a: A cleaning, filling or whitening is usually one visit. A root canal is one or two. Crowns and bridges take two. Implants and orthodontics run over months. You will be told the expected number at the assessment.

items.q: My gums bleed when I brush. Is that normal?
items.a: No — bleeding gums are the earliest sign of gum disease and are worth getting looked at. At this stage it is usually reversible with scaling and a change in brushing technique. Left alone it can progress to loose teeth.

items.q: From what age should children see a dentist?
items.a: Bring them for a first check-up once the milk teeth are through, around age two to three. Early visits are short and mostly about getting comfortable with the chair, which makes every later visit easier.
Yes. For severe pain, swelling, a knocked-out tooth or a broken front tooth, call or WhatsApp 96651 94569 during clinic hours and we will see you as soon as we can.
